title: Saved
textBlocks:
Hello Bravehearts
In today’s true Bible story
we see that the people have 
spoken AGAINST the Lord and Moses

The Lord sends snakes to bite them.
Then MOSES PRAYS.
So the Lord says that He will 
SAVE them 
if they look to a pole 
that Moses must put a BRONZE snake on.

The Lord provides a WAY for them to be SAVED
Just like WE ARE SAVED because JESUS DIED ON A CROSS

TALK TO JESUS
Dear Lord Jesus
Thank you for loving me
Thank you for saving me
by dying on the cross
Please help me to love You
and to follow You
Amen
